subject: Structured handoff matrix & kickoff timeline for Helicon.ai integration
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Tara Nguyen <tara@helicon.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 04 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Draft MAP & proposed kickoff week (Helicon.ai)

Tara — attaching a first-pass mutual action plan we discussed during the demo. Topline: proposed kickoff week the week of June 21, with a 6–8 week implementation window for the initial retrieval+context integration.

Attachments: MAP-structure-v1.xlsx

Key asks:
- Can your team confirm procurement timeline (PO / SOW)?
- Who will own data ingestion and sandbox access on your side?
- Any blackout dates in June/July we should avoid for cutover?

I've CC'd Soojin (Customer Success) to lead the handoff and prepare the detailed milestone matrix. Jordan — please stand by for a short internal pre-kickoff to align resources.

Thanks,
Marcus
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182
From: Tara Nguyen <tara@helicon.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 04 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft MAP & proposed kickoff week (Helicon.ai)

Marcus — thanks, received. Two quick notes before the MAP is finalized:
1) Procurement: our legal/procurement lead needs 10 business days to review the SOW after we receive the final doc; target PO issuance earliest July 6.
2) Ownership: data ingestion will be handled by my engineering lead, Luis Moreno (copied below). He prefers stage-based access rather than a single sandbox, i.e., dev -> staging -> prod keys.

Can the MAP reflect: procurement milestone (legal review window), staged credentials, and a soft-acceptance gate after verification in staging? That acceptance gate is critical for our internal signoff.

Also, June 23–25 are a hard blackout for us (company offsite). If kickoff is that week we will be delayed.

—Tara
Head of Product, Helicon.ai
tara@helicon.ai

Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Draft MAP & proposed kickoff week (Helicon.ai) — structured handoff matrix

Tara — thanks for the notes, that helps. I took Marcus's initial spreadsheet and converted it into a structured handoff matrix + timeline with owners and acceptance gates. Core changes:

- Procurement milestone expanded to include: SOW sent -> Legal review (10bd) -> PO issued -> Billing setup. Owner: Helicon (Tara) / Redwood (Marcus) for follow-up.
- Credentials: agree on staged credential rollout (Dev: week 0, Staging: week 2, Prod: post-acceptance). Owner: Helicon (Luis) / Redwood (Implementation Eng).
- Acceptance gates: soft-accept after staging verification (verification checklist) + final acceptance after 7 days of production smoke tests. Owner: Helicon product + Redwood CS.
- Hard blackout 6/23–6/25 accounted for; proposed kickoff moved to June 28 to avoid the offsite.

I included a compact milestone table here (dates are provisional — we can lock after procurement):

Milestone — Planned date — Owner (Helicon / Redwood) — Acceptance/Deliverable
- Kickoff call & environment access — 2027-06-28 — Tara / Soojin — Kickoff notes, access confirmed
- Dev credentials provisioned — 2027-06-29 — Luis / Redwood Eng — Dev keys, sample data ingest
- Staging integration complete — 2027-07-12 — Luis / Redwood Eng — Integration smoke tests passed
- Soft-accept (staging verification) — 2027-07-16 — Tara / Soojin — Staging verification checklist sign-off
- Prod credentials & cutover window — 2027-07-20 — Luis / Redwood Eng — Prod keys ready
- Final acceptance (7d production validation) — 2027-07-27 — Tara / Soojin — Final acceptance email

I've put the working sheet on Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2B_MAP_sheet (editable by Helicon). Attached the revision: MAP-final-draft.xlsx and a one-page SOW summary: sow_summary.pdf.

Next steps:
1) Tara: confirm the procurement timeline (PO target July 6) so we can lock dates.
2) Marcus: update the commercial sheet with the target PO date and confirm billing onboarding steps.
3) Priya/Jordan: can you confirm who from Implementation Engineering will be assigned? We should tentatively reserve a 0.5 FTE during kickoff weeks.

If that looks good I'll schedule a 45-min kickoff for June 28 (calendar invite to follow).

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com | +1 (646) 555-0147
